name: Caesar's Mailbox
intro: Target: mail03. An intern 'secured' the key with an ancient trick.
decode now understands a second cipher.
objective: Read the intern's note, work out how the key was scrambled, undo it, and submit the flag.
hints: Read note.txt, then look at the other file.
The note says every letter moved forward 3 places. Undo it by shifting back: decode caesar -3 <text>
Copy the text from key.txt (double-click it) and run: decode caesar -3 <paste>
